SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.S.C., Special Branch.
REPORT
Date September 3, 1940.
Subject. E. THEILHEIMER - Application No. A. 40/1959 for a "Floor Show" Licence.
Made by. D.P.S. Decembris. Forwarded by Supt. Mason.

With reference to the attached application
for a "Floor Show" licence, submitted by Mr. Edgar
Theilheimer in respect of premises located at 1124
Broadway East, the following particulars have been
obtained:-

Mr. Edgar Kurt Theilheimer, German-Jew,
merchant, born in Hamburg, Germany, on the 22-6-1901,
arrived in Shanghai in April 1939 on board the s.s.
Hakusan Maru. He is residing at Lane 737, House 19,
Broadway East.

The applicant is the owner of the "Tabarin"
at 1124 Broadway East, in respect of which establishment
he holds "Tavern" and "Dancing Saloon" licenses.

Mr. Theilheimer has engaged two German Jewish
artists, namely Mr. W. Friedmann, singer, and Miss Beatrice
toe-dancer, who are proposed to stage a floor show
between 9 p.m. and 12 m.n. nightly. Mr. Friedmann's
repertoire has been examined by the undersigned and was
found to consist of old Viennese songs which contain
nothing of an objectionable nature. Attached is a list
comprising the titles of Mr. Friedmann's entire repertoire.

The applicant has been warned that provided
he intends to add further songs to the programme, he
would have to submit scripts of all vocal numbers to
the Special Branch for approval, prior to their public
presentation.

There is nothing to the detriment of Mr.
Theilheimer's character in S.M. Police records.

D.O. "D" passed to you please.
D.C. (Special Branch).
D. P. S.

（右上角印章：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE REGISTRY File No. 345）
（左侧手写批注：Sent 3/9）
（左下角方框印章：INDEXED BY (A.A.) REGISTRY DATE 4/ 9/ 40）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特别处。
报告
日期：1940年9月3日。
事由：E. THEILHEIMER - 申请编号 A. 40/1959，申请“歌舞表演”执照。
呈报人：D.P.S. Decembris。由梅森（Mason）警司转呈。

关于埃德加·泰尔海默（Edgar Theilheimer）先生就位于百老汇路1124号（东）的处所提交的“歌舞表演”执照申请，经调查获得以下详情：

埃德加·库尔特·泰尔海默（Edgar Kurt Theilheimer），德籍犹太人，商人，1901年6月22日出生于德国汉堡，于1939年4月乘“白山丸”号（s.s. Hakusan Maru）轮抵达上海。现居住于百老汇路（东）737弄19号。

申请人系百老汇路（东）1124号“塔巴林”（Tabarin）舞厅的所有人，就该场所持有“酒馆”及“跳舞厅”执照。

泰尔海默先生已聘请两位德籍犹太艺人，即歌手W. 弗里德曼（W. Friedmann）先生和脚尖舞者比阿特丽斯（Beatrice）小姐，拟每晚9时至午夜12时进行歌舞表演。签名人已审查弗里德曼先生的曲目，发现均由古老的维也纳歌曲组成，不含任何不良内容。随函附上弗里德曼先生全部曲目的歌名清单。

已警告申请人，若其打算在节目中增加更多歌曲，必须在公开演出前将所有声乐节目的歌词脚本提交特别处审批。

在上海公共租界警务处档案中，无任何不利于泰尔海默先生品行的记录。

请转交“D”区巡官。
副督察长（特别处）。
D. P. S.

（右上角印章：上海公共租界警务处登记处 档案号 345）
（左侧手写批注：9月3日发出）
（左下角方框印章：由 (A.A.) 索引 登记日期 1940年9月4日）
